user_problem: I need to choose exactly two security controls from rate_limit, captcha, waf, and review_queue. Order does not matter and repeats are not allowed. Which pairs are safe for public API and admin API traffic, and how do coverage, friction, and cost trade off?
bundle_offer: Bundle models the control pair as FW_Combi(2): choose exactly two distinct controls, order irrelevant. It crosses the pair with traffic profile, uses a TAIL oracle for admin-without-WAF and public excessive-friction policies, and returns a coverage/friction/cost Pareto front with PASS-aware annotations.

zen_mapping.shape: k of n, order irrelevant, no repetition

oracle: FW_VAR=2 admin traffic pair is missing WAF; FW_VAR=3 public traffic pair has excessive friction; FW_VAR=0 safe

best_candidates.reason_non_dominated: champion: strictly best minimize cost_units (cost_units=3.000) on the 2-point Pareto front
champion: strictly best maximize coverage_score (coverage_score=96.00) on the 2-point Pareto front

pareto_front_note: the formal front is over ALL executed candidates; DOMAIN_FAIL members are findings, not deployable — pick the best PASS candidate to deploy
domain_fail_examples: app=control_pair traffic=admin_api controls=captcha+review_queue coverage_score=66 friction_score=9 cost_units=5 FW_VAR=2
app=control_pair traffic=public_api controls=captcha+review_queue coverage_score=55 friction_score=9 cost_units=5 FW_VAR=3
pass_example: app=control_pair traffic=public_api controls=review_queue+waf coverage_score=70 friction_score=7 cost_units=7 FW_VAR=0
teaching_summary: User problem (security control pair selection (FW_Combi(2))). Ran 12 candidates: 8x PASS (safe control pair), 3x admin traffic control pair is missing WAF, 1x public traffic control pair has excessive user friction. Formal Pareto front of 2. Verbs: choose exactly two security controls -> FW_Combi(2); traffic profile -> FW_Combi(1); control-pair policy -> TAIL oracle (FW_VAR). NOTE: 1 of 2 Pareto-front candidates are DOMAIN_FAIL (findings, not deployable): the formal front is over ALL executed candidates; DOMAIN_FAIL members are findings, not deployable — pick the best PASS candidate to deploy.
